title: DSWC – Docklands Sailing and Watersports Centre

text: .dswc-gcal { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; } .dswc-gcal-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 10px; } .dswc-gcal-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1.2em; } .dswc-gcal-prev, .dswc-gcal-next { text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; } /* Single-bordered grid: the grid's own background shows through the 1px gaps as shared lines between cells, instead of each cell carrying its own border (which would double up where they meet). */ .dswc-gcal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: #ccc; border: 1px solid #ccc; } .dswc-gcal-weekday { font-weight: 600; text-align: center; padding: 4px 2px; font-size: 0.85em; background: #f5f5f5; } .dswc-gcal-day { min-height: 80px; padding: 2px 3px; background: #fff; position: relative; } .dswc-gcal-day-outside { background: #fafafa; color: #aaa; } .dswc-gcal-day-today { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #007cba; } .dswc-gcal-day-number { font-size: 0.85em; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 2px; } /* Title gets the full pill width — only the inner text span truncates, so the popover (a sibling, not inside the truncating span) isn't clipped by its parent's overflow. */ .dswc-gcal-event { position: relative; font-size: 0.78em; background: #e7f3fe; border-left: 3px solid #007cba; padding: 1px 4px; margin-bottom: 2px; cursor: default; } .dswc-gcal-event-title-text { display: block; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .dswc-gcal-event-more { font-size: 0.75em; color: #666; } .dswc-gcal-event-popover { display: none; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 100%; z-index: 50; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #ccc; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); padding: 8px 10px; width: 50vw; min-width: 220px; max-width: 360px; white-space: normal; font-size: 1.1em; line-height: 1.4; color: #333; text-align: left; } .dswc-gcal-event:hover .dswc-gcal-event-popover, .dswc-gcal-event:focus-within .dswc-gcal-event-popover, .dswc-gcal-event:focus .dswc-gcal-event-popover { display: block; } /* Horizontal flow, by column position within the 7-day row (the weekday header row shifts every day cell's nth-child by +7, which these formulas already account for): - Columns 1-2 (leftmost): open rightward. - Columns 3-5 (middle three): open centered on the event. - Columns 6-7 (rightmost): open leftward. */ .dswc-gcal-day:nth-child(7n+1) .dswc-gcal-event-popover, .dswc-gcal-day:nth-child(7n+2) .dswc-gcal-event-popover { left: 0; right: auto; } .dswc-gcal-day:nth-child(7n+3) .dswc-gcal-event-popover, .dswc-gcal-day:nth-child(7n+4) .dswc-gcal-event-popover, .dswc-gcal-day:nth-child(7n+5) .dswc-gcal-event-popover { left: 50%; right: auto; transform: translateX(-50%); } .dswc-gcal-day:nth-child(7n+6) .dswc-gcal-event-popover, .dswc-gcal-day:nth-child(7n) .dswc-gcal-event-popover { left: auto; right: 0; } /* Vertical flow: the bottom two weeks of the visible grid open upward instead of downward. */ .dswc-gcal-day-flip-up .dswc-gcal-event-popover { top: auto; bottom: 100%; } .dswc-gcal-event-time { font-size: 0.85em; color: #555; margin-top: 2px; } .dswc-gcal-event-desc { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.9em; } .dswc-gcal-event-desc p { margin: 0 0 6px 0; } .dswc-gcal-event-desc a { color: #007cba; font-weight: 600; } .dswc-gcal-tagline { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 0.9em; color: #555; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .dswc-gcal-day { min-height: 60px; font-size: 0.85em; } } Located in the heart of London’s Docklands at the west end of Millwall outer dock, the Centre is based in an award-winning purpose-built facility with great views from the upstairs bar over the dock, and wet facilities downstairs. We are a Recognised Training Centre and deliver courses in sailing, windsurfing, powerboating and paddlesports. Our function rooms are available for private and corporate hire throughout the week and land-based events can also be tied in with our water-based activities, such as dragon boating, sailing or paddlesports to create a great day out for you. Please accept our apologies for any inconvenience. For any enquires, please contact info@dswc.org or alternatively call us on 020 7537 2626. Easter Holiday Activity Weeks We are pleased to announce the opening of bookings for Youth Activity Weeks during the Easter Holidays running 29th March – 1st April and 5th – 8th April. With the continuing COVID restrictions, and following the success of last years summer and autumn programme, the week will operate in the reformatted form so we can… Easter Youth Activity Weeks Bookings We are happy to announce that our Easter Youth Activity Weeks bookings will go live tomorrow Friday 05/03/21 at 1500. There are limited spaces, so if you would like to book a place for your child then please ensure you are available to book at the time listed above. Booking will be via our website… We’re Recruiting Now that the future is looking slightly clearer we are looking for staff to join our team for what is sure to be a busy season. Despite COVID-19 we still saw some 15,000 sessions delivered in 2020, join us and make 2021 even better.
